content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by the sign's own lack of a stated mechanism, so it applies a verse-level stating-verse test to a chain collision.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse / stating-verse test: I weighed whether K-C bars only explicit contrary-stating demands or also bars using a pressed verse's silence on a point as decisive; the judge did the latter.","why":"The judge treats Isaiah 7:14's own silence about the mechanism as decisive for underdetermination instead of weighing the parties' chains by footing."}
